thread:
Aisha: Quick alert 5m ago we started getting reports from onboarding customers that hybrid-search reranks are returning low-relevance top hits. Seeing it in both hosted and dedicated trials.
Connor: Looking at traces now. Early signal points to a feature-flag flip that changed batching behavior for hybrid queries. Some vectors are sent without normalization.
Renee: Ugh. That would definitely explain mismatched reranks. Can we scope which pools saw the flag?
Connor: Yes. Affected: two hosted clusters and three dedicated pools started receiving the wrong flag at 05:12 UTC after the rollout.
Vik: Ops can roll the flag back for the affected pools. ETA ~18m to complete and validate.
Aisha: We need an outbound note for impacted accounts. Keep it brief, no technical blame. Offer reindex assistance, say we're evaluating account credits, and schedule office hours for live help. Also flag renewal-risk accounts for 1:1.
Renee: Drafting short customer copy: "Hi 5m Were reaching out because some customers may have experienced lower-quality search results this morning due to a configuration change. Weve identified the cause and are rolling back the change for affected workloads. If you see incorrect search or rerank results, reply to this message or contact your CS rep and we will prioritize a manual reindex. We are evaluating account-level remediation and will follow up with an RCA. "
Eve (Legal): Swap "experienced" to "may have experienced" and avoid saying "weve identified the cause"  replace with "were investigating and taking corrective action". Also avoid committing to credits publicly.
Renee: Updated per legal. Removing cause wording and changing credit line to "we are evaluating account-level remediation".
Vik: Rollback started at 05:30 UTC for the three dedicated pools, 05:33 UTC for the hosted clusters. Telemetry shows similarity histograms moving back to baseline within the first validation window.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-1307 created, severity P2, bridge scheduled.
Connor: Post-rollback validation looks good so far. Will run a few full-query smoke tests and attach logs to the RCA.
Aisha: Good. Diego (CS outreach) please prepare high-touch email for renewal-risk list offering live troubleshooting + proposed remediation (suggested credit percentages will need approval).
Renee: Also preparing an in-product banner for impacted tenants that links to the CS thread and office hours. Draft of office hours: 45-min at 11:00 UTC.
Vik: One note: two very large tenants may still show stale reranks until we trigger a manual reindex. Tagging them for CS.
Aisha: Noted  adding to the renewal-risk list and scheduling 1:1s. After send, capture any customer replies in the account health tracker and escalate immediate conversion signals.
Connor: Final validation OK at 05:50 UTC. Will upload brief root-cause summary to the RCA doc (feature-flag gating and missing normalization test).
Renee: Final customer note posted to comms folder. Sending after Aisha sign-off.
Aisha: Sign-off given. Send now. Follow-up actions: 1) prioritize manual reindexes for the two large tenants, 2) collect feedback via short survey, 3) propose remediation credits for affected high-touch accounts.
